title: Traffic Ghost
tagline: Race your last run through a city that keeps changing lanes.
description: Drive a translucent car through a three-lane night route and try to outrun your own ghost. The traffic pattern stays readable for one run, then shuffles.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Traffic Ghost. Drive a translucent car through a three-lane night route and try to outrun your own ghost. The traffic pattern stays readable for one run, then shuffles.
